the clean fixture, part two: agent-transcript text.

clean.txt is 200 lines of ordinary code and prose and it has always passed with zero false
positives. it still let a rule ship that masked 165,088 things on a real corpus of 1,406
exchanges, because agent transcripts are not ordinary text. they are dense with high-entropy
IDENTIFIERS — tool-use ids, message ids, uuids, content hashes, build ids, url slugs — and none
of those is a credential. every shape below was taken from the *shape* of something measured by
scripts/redaction-benchmark.mjs on the reference corpus. nothing here is a real value.

the contract for this file: redact(elideBinary(this)) produces zero hits. one image payload is
included on purpose, so the assertion covers the pipeline ingest.ts actually runs and not just
the redactor.
